title: Непонятно, и понятно только после двух вопросов: «мне бы то же самое, что весной»
demonstrates: Rule R13 on a drafts channel, with the flagship's fourth advisor. The clarifying question is the draft; she writes her own over it, slowly and correctly. The first answer («ну колёса») does not settle it, because in the spring there were two jobs. She asks again by naming both, and the answer is: both. The last draft goes out as it was, and she adds one line of her own. Booked, labelled, resolved; the address is not in it.
